o.text: Borrowed from Russian га́лстук (gálstuk), ultimately from German Halstuch (“neckerchief”) or Dutch halsdoek (“neckerchief”).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish خانم. Equivalent to xan + -ım (first person singular possessive suffix). Cognate with Turkish hanım. See also: bəyim.
From Proto-Turkic *artuč, of unclear relation to *arča (“juniper”). Cognate with Karakhanid اَرْتُجْ (artuç), Turkish ardıç.
Borrowed from Turkish takipçi. Doublet of təqibçi (“pursuer, chaser, follower; crake”).
